## Details

<a id="entry_jump_table"></a>
### [`entry_jump_table`](../../../../src/init/entry.asm#L6) `$0900`

*routine*

JMP table at the start of the program. $0900 cold_start (the entry), $0903 wait_for_hit ($1c37), $0906 sample_pad, $0909 an RTS, $090c wait_jiffies, $090f hit_test, $0912 $1523, $0915 $1895, $0918 $275c. The program uses only $0900 and $0906 (from read_cursor at $19d8). The Mayday! release starts at $092f and does not execute $0900.

- **Jumps to:** [`cold_start`](entry.md#cold_start), [`wait_for_hit`](../input/hit_test.md#wait_for_hit)

<a id="cold_start"></a>
### [`cold_start`](../../../../src/init/entry.asm#L23) `$091B`

*routine*

Cold start: stops the interrupts, clears the decimal mode, sets the stack pointer to $ff and calls the KERNAL routines IOINIT, CINT, RESTOR, UNTLK and UNLSN. Then it sets the CIA 1 timer interrupt and the BRK and IRQ vectors, turns the interrupts on and prepares the menu screen (init_menu_screen). Then screen_off, the script at $1e1a, menu flash off, and start_main.

- **Jumped to from:** [`entry_jump_table`](entry.md#entry_jump_table)
- **Entry of:** [`entry_jump_table`](../../tables.md#entry_jump_table)
- **Calls:** [`IOINIT`](../../memory-map.md#IOINIT), [`CINT`](../../memory-map.md#CINT), [`RESTOR`](../../memory-map.md#RESTOR), [`UNTLK`](../../memory-map.md#UNTLK), [`UNLSN`](../../memory-map.md#UNLSN), [`set_irq_timer`](screen.md#set_irq_timer), [`init_menu_screen`](screen.md#init_menu_screen), [`screen_off`](screen.md#screen_off), [`run_script`](../script/interpreter.md#run_script), [`start_main`](start_0a8a.md#start_main)
- **Writes:** [`CIACRA`](../../memory-map.md#CIACRA), [`CIAICR`](../../memory-map.md#CIAICR), [`CBINV`](../../memory-map.md#CBINV), [`CINV`](../../memory-map.md#CINV), [`flash_enable`](../../memory-map.md#flash_enable)
